data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Aug 5, 2026

## [HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE...](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a73793fc5e9782cfd0cad2f)
HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE.... IM SURPRISED LULU AND GEORGIA is still in business. ..... I have emailed you guys 5 times with NO response ... how do you interact with customer issues. The negligence is unbelievable.

July 23, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Aug 6, 2026

We're very sorry to hear about your experience. We sincerely apologize if your previous emails were missed.

At this time, we don't see any active inquiries associated with your account, but we'd be happy to help. A Customer Experience Specialist will be assigned to review your order and reach out to assist you as soon as possible.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention, and we appreciate the opportunity to make things right.
